findings.title: Direct Conflict on Allergy Panel State: Automated Migration Populated vs Mandatory Empty at Go-Live

citations.verbatim_excerpt: All migrated allergy records shall be rendered immediately visible and active in the Aurora Allergy & Intolerance clinical summary panel upon initial user login at go-live.

The Aurora Allergy & Intolerance clinical summary panel shall be unpopulated and empty at go-live for all migrated patients to ensure unverified legacy data does not compromise acute prescribing decisions.
Legacy allergy data must never populate a clinical field because the Clinical Safety Group ruled it unsafe for prescribing due to inconsistent coding and unverified dosage thresholds in legacy PAS.

findings.why_incompatible: FDS-DM-04 mandates that 1.4 million legacy allergy records be ingested and made immediately active and visible in the clinical summary panel upon initial go-live login. Conversely, FDS-CLIN-11 explicitly forbids unverified legacy data ingestion into clinical fields, mandating that the panel remain completely empty until point-of-care clinician reconciliation.
findings.consequence: Severe patient safety hazard and prescribing risk. Clinicians may rely on unverified, incorrectly coded legacy allergy data during acute prescribing, or conversely, automated ETL jobs will overwrite clinical safety hard-stops.

findings.title: Algorithmic Free-Text Severity Derivation Prohibited by Clinical Safety Group

citations.verbatim_excerpt: Allergy severity classifications (Mild, Moderate, Severe, Life-Threatening) shall be algorithmically inferred from legacy free-text clinical notes and mapped into Aurora Severity tiers using regex keyword extraction.

Allergy severity and adverse reaction manifestations must be captured directly from the patient at first appointment, never inferred or derived from automated algorithms or unverified historical free-text notes.

findings.why_incompatible: FDS-DM-04 requirement DM-04-R04 mandates regex-based automated severity extraction from unstructured free-text notes, whereas FDS-CLIN-11 requirement CLIN-11-R05 strictly prohibits algorithmic or free-text severity inference, establishing direct patient elicitation as mandatory.
findings.consequence: Patients risk fatal adverse drug events due to misclassified severity (e.g., missed anaphylaxis or false high-risk flags leading to alert fatigue or inappropriate contraindication overrides).
